newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ANGLO AMERICAN CORP ZIMBABWE NAMES CHIEF EXECUTIVE.
newsitem.headline: ANGLO AMERICAN CORP ZIMBABWE NAMES CHIEF EXECUTIVE.

text.p: Anglo American Corporation Zimbabwe (AMZIM) has appointed South African Philip Baum its new chief executive from October 1.
Baum was previously secretary to the executive committee of parent Anglo American Corporation based in South Africa.
In a statement, AMZIM also said Zimbabwean Elias Ngugama, its former chief executive at subsidiary Bindura Nickel Corporation, would become non-executive chairman from next March.
Baum, 42, and Ngugama, 57, both succeed Zimbabwean Roy Lander who has been chairman and chief executive of Anglo American Zimbabwe for the last 10 years.

Baum, a white, comes to Zimbabwe despite earlier threats by President Robert Mugabe's government to stop his appointment ahead of a black Zimbabwean as part of its campaign to promote economic empowerment of majority blacks.
Baum told reporters in Harare on Thursday, he had been assured a work permit by the Zimbabwean authorities.
